title: What is a clinical associate psychologist? (CAP)

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚取超越出卖时间换金钱的收入，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特（Marianne Trent）博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特（Sophie Foote）的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年参加并完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的转化之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖品以及我个人的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特汉姆和梅森（Fortnum and Mason）的礼品，以及限时的一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请查看简介中链接的我的福利页面。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Coming up today, we are diving back in for a look at the role of clinical associate psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们将再次深入探讨临床副心理学家的角色。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: How do you train?
sentences.zh: 你要如何接受培训？

sentences.en: Do you get paid?
sentences.zh: 你能拿到薪水吗？

sentences.en: All the details you need to know.
sentences.zh: 你需要了解的所有细节。

sentences.en: Hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这些内容非常有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Now we are going to be chatting today with a fellow qualified clinical psychologist who has a very different role to me.
sentences.zh: 今天我们将与另一位合格的临床心理学家进行交谈，她的角色与我非常不同。

sentences.en: And I just love the diversity of the profession.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这个职业的多样性了。

sentences.en: Hope that you will find this really useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你会发现这期节目非常有用。

sentences.en: We have spoken about the role of clinical associate psychologist before.
sentences.zh: 我们以前讨论过临床副心理学家的角色。

sentences.en: That was about two years ago with Elise Dyer.
sentences.zh: 那大约是两年前和埃莉斯·戴尔（Elise Dyer）一起录制的。

sentences.en: And we were speaking about children and young people.
sentences.zh: 当时我们讨论的是儿童和青少年。

sentences.en: So if you might find that episode helpful, please do dig that out.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得那一期节目对你有帮助，请务必找出来听听。

sentences.en: Otherwise, I hope you find this really useful and I'll look forward to catching up with you at the end of this.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，希望你觉得这一期很有用，我期待在节目结束时与你交流。

sentences.en: Hi, I just want to welcome along our guest for today, Dr. Dawn Reeves.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我只想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾道恩·里夫斯（Dawn Reeves）博士。

sentences.en: Hi, Dawn.
sentences.zh: 嗨，道恩。

sentences.en: Thanks for joining us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你加入我们。

sentences.en: Hi, you're welcome.
sentences.zh: 嗨，不客气。

sentences.en: It's nice to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: So we're getting together today because you are a qualified clinical psychologist, but also we're thinking today about your current role,
sentences.zh: 我们今天聚在一起，是因为你是一位合格的临床心理学家，同时我们今天也想探讨你目前的角色，

sentences.en: which is training clinical associate psychologists or CAPs as we as we kind of think of them in psychology.
sentences.zh: 也就是培训临床副心理学家，或者我们在心理学界简称的CAPs。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I work in EPUT and we have a CAP apprenticeship training program and we run that in partnership with Essex University.
sentences.zh: 是的，我在EPUT工作，我们有一个CAP学徒培训项目，我们与埃塞克斯大学合作运营这个项目。

sentences.en: So it's an 18-month program, but just 12 months of those cover the academic aspect of the program.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个为期18个月的项目，其中只有12个月涵盖了项目的学术部分。

sentences.en: And throughout those 18 months, you should be on a work placement.
sentences.zh: 在这18个月里，你应该都在实习岗位上工作。

sentences.en: You're employed in an NHS.
sentences.zh: 你在英国国民医疗服务体系（NHS）受雇。

sentences.en: Usually it's an NHS setting and you're supervised by a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 通常是在NHS的环境中，并且由一名临床心理学家进行监督。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So always supervised by a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以总是由临床心理学家来监督吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I believe it can also be a registered psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我相信也可以是其他注册心理学家。

sentences.en: So it could be that it'd be a counseling psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以也有可能是咨询心理学家。

sentences.en: You need to, I believe the stipulation is that you have to be HCPC registered as a practicing psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我的理解是，规定必须是在HCPC（英国健康与护理专业委员会）注册的执业心理学家。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So we're looking for the practitioner psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在寻找执业心理学家。

sentences.en: So, you know, sometimes when people are thinking, oh, I'd love to be a clinical psychologist one day, they can be dissuaded by being supervised by different discipline.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有时当人们想着“哦，我有一天好想成为临床心理学家”时，他们可能会因为由不同学科的人监督而打退堂鼓。

sentences.en: But I was actually supervised by a forensic psychologist as the role before I got on to training.
sentences.zh: 但在我进入培训之前的上一份工作中，我实际上是由一位法医心理学家监督的。

sentences.en: And so in my experience, it's the practitioner psychologist element that's really important rather than necessarily which discipline it is.
sentences.zh: 所以根据我的经验，真正重要的是“执业心理学家”这个要素，而不一定非要是哪个具体学科。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So it's about being registered and recognized profession within psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以这关乎是否是心理学领域内注册并认可的职业。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Could you, just before we kind of really think and delve deep into the CAT role and your role within that, could you tell us a little bit about your background,
sentences.zh: 在我们在真正思考和深入探讨CAP角色以及你在其中的角色之前，你能否跟我们分享一下你的背景，

sentences.en: how you got into psychology and where you trained, those sort of things, if that feels okay?
sentences.zh: 你是如何进入心理学领域的，以及你在哪里受过培训，诸如此类的事情，如果这让你觉得方便的话？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So way, way back as an undergraduate student, I went to Brunel University and back then we, they used to run a very thin sandwich undergraduate degree,
sentences.zh: 很久很久以前，作为一名本科生，我去了布鲁内尔大学（Brunel University），当时他们开设了一种非常轻度的三明治式本科课程，

sentences.en: which would be six months study and six months work placement.
sentences.zh: 也就是六个月学习和六个月工作实习交替。

sentences.en: You did that for three years.
sentences.zh: 你这样做了三年。

sentences.en: And then your final fourth year was be one academic year.
sentences.zh: 然后你的最后第四年是一个完整的学年。

sentences.en: So there were often a lot of placements for prisons or student psychologists in prison.
sentences.zh: 当时有很多针对监狱或学生心理学家的监狱实习岗位。

sentences.en: So I worked in a prison for about six months on a sex offender treatment program.
sentences.zh: 所以我曾在监狱里工作了大约六个月，参与一个性犯罪者治疗项目。

sentences.en: So that gave me an insight into that kind of more, I suppose, clinical work, but I did mostly assessment work.
sentences.zh: 这让我对这种更偏向临床的工作有了一些了解，但我做的大多是评估工作。

sentences.en: So when I graduated, I wanted to work in that area,
sentences.zh: 所以当我毕业时，我想在那个领域工作，

sentences.en: but I didn't manage to be successful in getting through the sort of selection process for working in the prison service because that's back then it would be a master's program.
sentences.zh: 但我没能成功通过监狱服务部门工作的选拔流程，因为当时那需要硕士课程。

sentences.en: And then I thought about doing educational psychology.
sentences.zh: 然后我考虑过做教育心理学。

sentences.en: At that point, my psychology degree didn't have enough maths, I believe, was their point about why I couldn't train as a teacher,
sentences.zh: 那时，我的心理学学位数学学分不够，我记得他们当时就是这么指出为什么我不能接受教师培训的，

sentences.en: which you needed to do to be an educational psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 而那是成为教育心理学家所必需的。

sentences.en: And then I started to apply for assistant psychology poSt.
sentences.zh: 接着我开始申请心理学助理的职位。

sentences.en: So I managed to get one of those and learned about how you could apply for clinical training from other assistants that I was working with.
sentences.zh: 我成功得到了一个职位，并从同事的其他助理那里了解到如何申请临床培训。

sentences.en: So I gave that a shot and I was very lucky that I actually got accepted on a course, Salomon's course, my first application.
sentences.zh: 于是我尝试了一下，非常幸运的是，我在第一次申请时就被萨洛蒙斯（Salomons）课程录取了。

sentences.en: So I think a large part of that was because I had done that work in the prison service and in another placement on a third year,
sentences.zh: 所以我想很大一部分原因是因为我在监狱服务部门做过那项工作，而且在第三年的另一个实习中，

sentences.en: I'd also worked in educational psychology department.
sentences.zh: 我也曾在教育心理学部门工作过。

sentences.en: So I had that sort of work experience before I actually graduated, which I think made a difference.
sentences.zh: 所以在毕业前我就有了那种工作经验，我认为这起到了作用。

sentences.en: So, yeah, after I finished my doctorate, I worked and specialized with older people.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，完成博士学位后，我在老年人领域工作并专攻于此。

sentences.en: So I've worked in different community mental health teams, some in London, Leicester and in Bedfordshire.
sentences.zh: 我在不同的社区心理健康团队工作过，有些在伦敦、莱斯特和贝德福德郡。

sentences.en: And I've always been involved in some level of sort of teaching or education.
sentences.zh: 而且我一直都或多或少地参与一些教学或教育工作。

sentences.en: When I was a qualified psychologist,
sentences.zh: 当我成为一名合格的心理学家时，

sentences.en: I sort of would do some of the what they call honorary lecturing in doctorate psychology courses and give some workshops on older people and mental health because that was my specialty.
sentences.zh: 我有时会在心理学博士课程中担任所谓的名誉讲师，并就老年人与心理健康举办一些工作坊，因为那是我的专长。

sentences.en: And I worked for a time in Saudi Arabia for a couple of years on a clinical psychology program.
sentences.zh: 我还在沙特阿拉伯的一个临床心理学项目工作过一段时间，呆了几年。

sentences.en: They're helping to develop that.
sentences.zh: 在那里协助开发这个项目。

sentences.en: So does that give a good summary?
sentences.zh: 这算是一个很好的总结吗？

sentences.en: It really does.
sentences.zh: 确实非常棒。

sentences.en: What a varied career you've had.
sentences.zh: 你的职业生涯真是丰富多彩啊。

sentences.en: And, you know, I just I'm never I've never stopped getting blown away by, you know, the variety people have within their career.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，人们在职业生涯中展现出的多样性，总是让我惊叹不已，从未停止过这种感受。

sentences.en: And I can just imagine all of these different experiences just, you know, crystallizing in your brain as kind of experience, you know,
sentences.zh: 我能想象到所有这些不同的经历，都在你的大脑中沉淀凝结成了经验，你知道的，

sentences.en: working in kind of forensic services and then working in Saudi.
sentences.zh: 比如在法医服务部门工作，然后在沙特工作。

sentences.en: So such novel but important things that you learn so much about working with people, working with systems, working with teams, working about with clinical populations.
sentences.zh: 这些都是如此新颖但又极其重要的事情，让你学到了很多关于如何与人共事、与系统共事、与团队共事，以及如何与临床人群打交道的知识。

sentences.en: You know, we really do do such varied work, don't we, in our profession?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在自己的职业生涯中确实从事着如此丰富多样的工做，对吧？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全是这样。

sentences.en: There won't ever be.
sentences.zh: 绝不会有。

sentences.en: I don't think there's ever a repetitive day.
sentences.zh: 我认为永远不会有重复的一天。

sentences.en: And I think that's what, for me, made psychology attractive and probably what's kept me in the role for this long is that I don't feel one week is the same to the next week.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是为什么对我来说，心理学很有吸引力，也可能是让我这个岗位坚持这么久的原因，就是我觉得没有哪一周和下一周是相同的。

sentences.en: And you can get involved in or be asked as well to get involved into so many pieces of work, educational work, training work, there's research, there's therapeutic work,
sentences.zh: 你可以参与或者被邀请参与到如此众多的工作中去，教育工作、培训工作、研究、治疗工作、

sentences.en: there's staff work and teams work, organisational work.
sentences.zh: 员工工作、团队工作、组织工作。

sentences.en: So you can sort of find where your interests lie.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以找到你的兴趣所在。

sentences.en: I think it's not a dull job, I don't think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这不是一份枯燥的工作，我是这么认为的。

sentences.en: I don't know what you think.
sentences.zh: 不知道你是怎么想的。

sentences.en: Oh, it's not at all.
sentences.zh: 哦，一点也不枯燥。

sentences.en: No, I agree.
sentences.zh: 对，我同意。

sentences.en: And I think people that often don't understand what we do in clinical psychology might say, isn't it just loads of people moaning all the time?
sentences.zh: 而且我认为那些经常不理解我们在临床心理学中做什么的人可能会说，这不就是一堆人整天在抱怨吗？

sentences.en: And I'm like, no, it's not that.
sentences.zh: 而我会说，不，根本不是这样的。

sentences.en: Even when you're doing kind of therapy or direct work with clients, it's not that.
sentences.zh: 即使你在做某种治疗或与客户直接接触的工作，也不是那样的。

sentences.en: It isn't that.
sentences.zh: 根本不是那回事。

sentences.en: Like, if that's all it is, then you're not doing your role properly.
sentences.zh: 如果这就是全部，那你就是没有尽到自己的职责。

sentences.en: You know, it's not a passive process, is it?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这不是一个被动的过程，对吧？

sentences.en: It should be really active and you should be constantly trying to, in my experience, constantly trying to kind of fit a bespoke approach for this client,
sentences.zh: 它应该是非常积极主动的，根据我的经验，你应该不断地尝试为这个客户量身定制一种方法，

sentences.en: which means that it's a very active process for the professional, but also a really active dynamic process for the client.
sentences.zh: 这意味着对专业人员来说这是一个非常积极的过程，对客户来说也是一个真正积极且动态的过程。

sentences.en: It isn't just a venting space to go and moan.
sentences.zh: 这绝不仅仅是一个去发泄和抱怨的空间。

sentences.en: Like, in my experience, that's not at all the case.
sentences.zh: 就我的经验而言，根本不是这样的。

sentences.en: Yeah, you've got, I mean, if you're going to get anything out of psychology, you have to put something in, don't you?
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，如果你想从心理学中获得什么，你就必须投入什么，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, I think a large part of a lot of psychologists, they are kind of trainers and teachers because they're trying to help when you're doing individual work,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为很大一部分心理学家，他们某种程度上也是培训师和老师，因为当你做个别工作时，

sentences.en: individuals learn different ways of doing things to try and help with whatever situation has brought them to your service.
sentences.zh: 你是在帮助个人学习不同的做事方式，以试图应对将他们带到你们服务机构的任何状况。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: Lovely.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So, tell us about your current role then, kind of working with trainee CAPs.
sentences.zh: 那么，给我们讲讲你目前的工作吧，也就是与实习CAPs共事。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, the CAP role is relatively new and I work in an NHS trust, EPIT, and we have created a CAP apprenticeship program.
sentences.zh: 所以，CAP这个角色相对较新，我在一个NHS信托机构EPUT工作，我们创建了一个CAP学徒项目。

sentences.en: What does that stand for, Dawn?
sentences.zh: 那代表什么意思呢，道恩？

sentences.en: What does EPIT stand for?
sentences.zh: EPUT代表什么？

sentences.en: It's all right.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: Essex Partnership University TruSt.
sentences.zh: 埃塞克斯合伙人大学NHS信托基金（Essex Partnership University Trust）。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: We work, I work in a training department.
sentences.zh: 我们工作，我在一个培训部门工作。

sentences.en: So, they've developed the MSC for the CAP, Clinical Associate in Psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以他们为CAP（临床副心理学家）开发了理学硕士学位（MSC）。

sentences.en: That's in partnership with Essex University.
sentences.zh: 那是与埃塞克斯大学合作进行的。

sentences.en: So, I have worked on that program since it began.
sentences.zh: 所以自从这个项目开始以来，我就一直参与其中。

sentences.en: And I'd say we're sort of developing it with each cohort.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，我们一直在随着每一届学员的发展而不断完善它。

sentences.en: We're now on, coming up to cohort five.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正迎向第五届学员。

sentences.en: We started with focusing on adult mental health CAPs.
sentences.zh: 我们最初专注于成人心理健康CAPs。

sentences.en: So, they were in placements in NHS adult focus services.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在NHS以成人为重点的服务机构中实习。

sentences.en: And for us, that was across Essex and Hertfordshire.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，那横跨埃塞克斯和赫特福德郡。

sentences.en: So, it's not necessary that you have to have worked in EPIT, Essex Partnership University TruSt.
sentences.zh: 所以你不一定非要在EPUT（埃塞克斯合伙人大学NHS信托基金）工作过。

sentences.en: But it's kind of around geographically, which programs nearby, because there's quite a few programs around the country now.
sentences.zh: 但这取决于地理位置，看附近有哪些项目，因为现在全国有很多这样的项目了。

sentences.en: So, I've helped with setting up the CAPs program.
sentences.zh: 所以我协助建立并设立了CAPs项目。

sentences.en: I initially started with being a module lead for developing one of the modules, which was on assessment formulation and presentation.
sentences.zh: 我最初负责开发其中一个模块并担任模块负责人，该模块关于评估、构思和呈现（assessment formulation and presentation）。

sentences.en: I'm currently a deputy lead on that program.
sentences.zh: 我目前是该项目的副负责人。

sentences.en: So, that can involve lots of different roles, helping develop, continue to develop a course, be a course tutor.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能涉及许多不同的角色，帮助开发、持续改进课程，担任课程导师。

sentences.en: So, you work with CAPs and their placement supervisors, which is actually quite an important part of the CAP program.
sentences.zh: 所以你要与CAPs及其实习督导合作，这实际上是CAP项目非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: You have to have, yep.
sentences.zh: 你必须有，是的。

sentences.en: So, there's a tripartite review that has to be scheduled for every 12 weeks during the 18-month program.
sentences.zh: 所以在18个月的项目期间，必须安排每12周进行一次三方评审。

sentences.en: And that's done with the student, the clinical supervisor and the course tutor.
sentences.zh: 这是由学生、临床督导和课程导师共同完成的。

sentences.en: So, that's just to keep an eye on what's going on in placement,
sentences.zh: 这只是为了跟进了解实习期间的进展情况，

sentences.en: how the student is progressing in learning objectives through their workplace and adjusting for any issues that might be coming up as well.
sentences.zh: 以及学生在工作场所中如何通过学习目标取得进展，并随之调整可能出现的任何问题。

sentences.en: That sounds really important.
sentences.zh: 听起来真的很重要。

sentences.en: It's bringing back slightly horrifying memories of being a trainee and having mid-placement reviews.
sentences.zh: 这勾起了一些当实习生和进行中期评估时的恐怖回忆。

sentences.en: And, you know, that question where it gets asked, is there any chance that the trainee could fail this placement?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，总会有那样一个问题：实习生未能通过这次实习的可能性有多大？

sentences.en: Is it that kind of thing, like, but you're doing every 12 weeks?
sentences.zh: 是这种性质的吗？比如，每12周进行一次？

sentences.en: It is, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And the 12 weeks is to, you know, if there are any early indications that the placement might not be going well.
sentences.zh: 而这12周的意义在于，你知道，如果有什么早期迹象表明实习可能不太顺利的话。

sentences.en: It's about figuring out what we can do about that, because something that can come up is about opportunities for learning.
sentences.zh: 这关乎弄清楚我们能为此做些什么，因为可能会出现的一个问题就是关于学习机会。

sentences.en: So, if a student,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果一个学生，

sentences.en: but most of the time it's students and supervisors find that maybe there's not as many cases available to them to carry out some of the objectives that they need to complete for their training.
sentences.zh: 但大多数时候，学生和主管会发现，他们可能没有那么多可用的案例来开展完成培训所需的一些目标。

sentences.en: So, we can think through what other opportunities there might be.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们可以共同思考还可能有哪些其他机会。

sentences.en: I mean, I suppose it would be better to give an idea.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得举个例子会更直观一点。

sentences.en: So, if we, for instance, have a student who's working in an assessment-only service, a part of the CAP trainings, you have to do some amount of intervention work.
sentences.zh: 所以，比方说，如果我们有一个在纯评估服务机构工作的学生——作为CAP培训的一部分，你必须做一定量的干预工作。

sentences.en: You have to learn intervention skills.
sentences.zh: 你必须学习干预技能。

sentences.en: So, it might be that that's difficult for a supervisor and the student to access those sort of cases.
sentences.zh: 因此，对主管和学生来说，要接触到这类案例可能会比较困难。

sentences.en: So, we can use meetings like that to think about how that can be done.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们可以利用这样的会议来思考如何做到这一点。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And what is involved in a typical kind of trainee or even, for that matter, qualified CAP intervention?
sentences.zh: 那么，典型的一名实习CAP，甚至是有资格的CAP干预，通常包含哪些内容呢？

sentences.en: What might be typical?
sentences.zh: 典型的情况会是怎样的？

sentences.en: Gosh, I don't think there would be a typical because it really depends on the service.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我觉得不会有什么典型情况，因为这完全取决于具体的服务机构。

sentences.en: So, CAPs, I think that's the distinguishing part about CAPs training is they're trained into a service.
sentences.zh: 所以，CAP，我认为CAP培训的独特之处在于他们是在某个具体服务机构中接受培训的。

sentences.en: So, if you think about clinical psychology doctorate, you get trained, typically, you will be trained in difference or services across those three years.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你想想临床心理学博士项目，你会接受培训，通常会在那三年的不同服务机构中轮转培训。

sentences.en: You'll be having usually a six-month placement and coming in and out.
sentences.zh: 你通常会有六个月的实习期，进进出出。

sentences.en: I know some courses now, the placements are for a bit longer.
sentences.zh: 我知道现在有些课程的实习期稍微长一点。

sentences.en: But typically, it would be about six months.
sentences.zh: 但通常情况下，大概是六个月左右。

sentences.en: So, with the CAP, they're in one service.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于CAP来说，他们是在一个服务机构里。

sentences.en: They're employed in the service.
sentences.zh: 他们受雇于该服务机构。

sentences.en: And the hope is that that CAP would continue in that service once they've qualified.
sentences.zh: 人们的期望是，这位CAP在获得资格后会继续在该服务机构工作。

sentences.en: So, the service is trained them up to be, you know, skilled in that particular area of work.
sentences.zh: 因此，服务机构对他们进行培训，使他们，你知道的，在该特定工作领域具备熟练技能。

sentences.en: So, you can think that the different services that we have our CAP students in at the moment can be learning disability services, adult mental health services,
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象，目前我们的CAP学生所在的各种服务机构可能是学习障碍服务机构、成人心理健康服务机构、

sentences.en: health psychology services.
sentences.zh: 健康心理学服务机构。

sentences.en: And we've got some older adult services, autism assessment services.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一些老年人服务机构、自闭症评估服务机构。

sentences.en: So, it's a real mix.
sentences.zh: 所以真的是非常多样化。

sentences.en: So, each CAP is going to have a very different experience of their training from the perspective of their actual placement.
sentences.zh: 因此，从实际实习的角度来看，每个CAP对培训的体验都会非常不同。

sentences.en: Although, the learning objectives are all going to be the same.
sentences.zh: 尽管学习目标都是一样的。

sentences.en: So, each placement has to meet specific learning objectives set out by the apprenticeship standards and BPS standards as well.
sentences.zh: 因此，每次实习都必须达到由学徒制标准以及BPS（英国心理学会）标准所规定的具体学习目标。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你提供这些信息。

sentences.en: And am I right in thinking that it's not only is it a master's program, but it's also a funded program as well.
sentences.zh: 我这样理解对吗：它不仅是一个硕士项目，同时也是一个带资助的项目。

sentences.en: So, you get paid to do your master's and paid to do your training.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，你读硕士有报酬，培训也有报酬。

sentences.en: So, it really is incredible as an opportunity for people.
sentences.zh: 所以对人们来说，这确实是一个绝佳的机会。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, it's a fully paid master's apprenticeship.
sentences.zh: 这是一个全额带薪的硕士学徒项目。

sentences.en: So, the apprenticeship part of it is where the funding comes from.
sentences.zh: 所以，学徒制的那部分就是资金的来源。

sentences.en: So, your master's is paid for.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，你的硕士学费是有人支付的。

sentences.en: Well, you're not paying for the master's and you're in paid employment.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你不用自己付硕士学费，而且你有带薪工作。

sentences.en: You are employed by the trust that you are in a placement with.
sentences.zh: 你受雇于为你提供实习机会的信托机构（Trust）。

sentences.en: So, you're not employed by, for instance, EPIP, the NHS trust that's providing this training program, for instance, the one I work with.
sentences.zh: 所以你不是受雇于，比如说，EPIP——提供这个培训项目的NHS信托机构，比如我合作的那家。

sentences.en: You're employed by your service that you're working into.
sentences.zh: 你是受雇于你所工作的那个服务机构。

sentences.en: So, yeah, you're employed at a band five.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你是按Band 5的薪级受雇的。

sentences.en: Perhaps I should say that as well.
sentences.zh: 也许我也应该顺便提一下这一点。

sentences.en: So, as an apprentice, you'll be employed a band five.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为学徒，你将按Band 5的薪级受雇。

sentences.en: Once you qualify as a CAP, you should then go up to be employed as a band six.
sentences.zh: 一旦你获得CAP资格，你的薪级就应该提升到Band 6。

sentences.en: In terms of thinking about where someone's level will remain, there's no reason why, for instance, as a CAP, you would then perhaps progress into the banding once you're qualified.
sentences.zh: 就考虑某人的职级将停留在哪里而言，没有理由说，比如作为一名CAP，你在取得资格后不能晋升到更高的薪级。

sentences.en: But that would depend, obviously, on further training in England.
sentences.zh: 但很显然，这取决于在英格兰的进一步培训。

sentences.en: As far as I know, in Wales, I think they've recently started or they're developing their CAP's training program.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，在威尔士，我想他们最近刚开始或者正在开发他们的CAP培训项目。

sentences.en: And I believe they're going to start working at band seven once they're qualified.
sentences.zh: 我相信他们取得资格后将从Band 7开始工作。

sentences.en: So, there is some variation in the different regions.
sentences.zh: 因此，不同地区存在一些差异。

sentences.en: But in England, you would start at band six once you qualified.
sentences.zh: 但在英格兰，一旦你取得资格，你将从Band 6开始。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 原来如此。

sentences.en: It's so brilliant.
sentences.zh: 这真是太棒了。

sentences.en: And actually, in terms of, you know, diversity and inclusion and reducing inequality in psychology, if, you know, because a master's is not a cheap thing, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，从你知道的多元化、包容性以及减少心理学领域不平等的角度来看，因为读硕士可不便宜，你知道的。

sentences.en: And if you're then not able to, if you're not able to work either because you're studying for your master's, it's really difficult.
sentences.zh: 如果你随后无法工作，或者因为你在攻读硕士而无法工作，那就太难了。

sentences.en: So, this is a really wonderful way of people being able to access higher education.
sentences.zh: 所以，这真的是人们获得高等教育机会的一种绝妙方式。

sentences.en: And they may choose to stay as a CAP.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会选择继续留在CAP岗位上。

sentences.en: You know, that might just be, I guess that's the trust's hope that they will just stay as a qualified CAP, really.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这可能正是——我想这也是信托机构的期望，希望他们能作为合格的CAP留下来。

sentences.en: But it's such a brilliant and inclusive way of being able to access a master's qualification.
sentences.zh: 但这真的是一种极其精彩且包容的方式，让人能够获得硕士学位。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think services are very different as well in what they're doing with their CAP's once they qualify.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得各个服务机构在对待获得资格的CAP方面也非常不同。

sentences.en: So, yeah, absolutely, services would like them to stay and work as a CAP.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，当然，服务机构希望他们留下来并作为CAP工作。

sentences.en: But I know that services are actually investing in their qualified CAP's as well and providing access to further training.
sentences.zh: 但我知道，服务机构实际上也在投资他们合格的CAP，并为他们提供接受进一步培训的机会。

sentences.en: So, there's more specialist training.
sentences.zh: 所以还有更专业的培训。

sentences.en: There is a limit when you're qualifying as a CAP because it's an NHS England funded apprenticeship.
sentences.zh: 当你获得CAP资格时是有限制的，因为这是一个由英格兰NHS资助的学徒项目。

sentences.en: That means that you can't access any further funding, NHS funded training for another two years once you qualify.
sentences.zh: 这意味着一旦你获得资格，在接下来的两年内你不能获得任何由NHS资助的进一步培训资金。

sentences.en: But if you were to pay for a course yourself or if your service decided to pay for it and budget for that, you could still go and do it.
sentences.zh: 但如果你自己掏钱报班，或者你的服务机构决定为此出资并做预算，你仍然可以去读。

sentences.en: So, you're not restricted in that way.
sentences.zh: 所以你不会在这方面受到限制。

sentences.en: But there's a limit, you know, there's a limit in terms of the amount of funding you can get from the NHS.
sentences.zh: 但确实有限制，你知道的，从你能从NHS获得的资金数额来看是有限制的。

sentences.en: I hope that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 希望这讲得通。

sentences.en: It really does.
sentences.zh: 确实讲得通。

sentences.en: It really does, yes.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，是的。

sentences.en: So, in 2020, it was announced by Health Education England that that limit would be around and it was almost around immediately.
sentences.zh: 所以在2020年，英格兰健康教育局（Health Education England）宣布了这一限制，并且几乎立刻就实施了。

sentences.en: But there was some petitioning done.
sentences.zh: 但当时有一些请愿活动。

sentences.en: It was led by Erkan White, who was an aspiring psychologist at the time and is now a trainee.
sentences.zh: 这是由埃尔坎·怀特（Erkan White）领导的，他当时是一名有志成为心理学家的人，现在是一名实习生。

sentences.en: And that was overhauled and delayed for a couple of years.
sentences.zh: 后来这一规定被彻底审查并推迟了几年。

sentences.en: But certainly that is in force now.
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，现在该规定已经正式生效了。

sentences.en: So, in the beginning, we had some CAPs that that didn't apply to.
sentences.zh: 所以在一开始，我们有一些不受此限制影响的CAP。

sentences.en: So, they were able to, I believe, access funding sooner.
sentences.zh: 因此，我相信他们能够更早地获得资金支持。

sentences.en: But the CAPs that are on training now, there's that two-year limit.
sentences.zh: 但现在正在接受培训的CAP，则受到那两年限制的约束。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And if things don't go well, you know, do people sometimes choose to stop in the middle of their training?
sentences.zh: 如果事情进展不顺利，你知道的，人们有时会选择在培训中途停下来吗？

sentences.en: Or sometimes do they not meet the criteria so they're, in essence, kind of retired from the system?
sentences.zh: 或者有时是因为没有达到标准，所以实质上被这个系统“劝退”了？

sentences.en: Has that happened so far?
sentences.zh: 目前发生过这种情况吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, there is flexibility within the apprenticeship rules that you can actually take a break in learning.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，学徒制规则内确实有一定的灵活性，你实际上可以暂停学习。

sentences.en: So, if you find that whatever circumstances are going on that mean you can't carry on with your training at the moment, it could be through health or life circumstances,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你发现无论出于什么情况导致你目前无法继续培训——可能是由于健康或生活状况，

sentences.en: it could be the placement itself, you can actually request a break in learning.
sentences.zh: 也可能是由于实习本身，你实际上可以申请暂停学习。

sentences.en: And we have had examples of that, and I believe you can have a break up to 12 months, up to a year.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有过这样的例子，而且我相信你可以暂停长达12个月，也就是最长一年。

sentences.en: Typically, you know, the person will carry on working in some capacity, just not in that CAP role.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，你知道的，这个人会以某种身份继续工作，只是不在那个CAP岗位上。

sentences.en: And then you can come back into the programme at the point at which you left.
sentences.zh: 然后你可以在你离开的那个时间点重新回到项目中。

sentences.en: So, in terms of, like, the learning stage that you left, you will have to, in those situations, make your own efforts to find a new placement.
sentences.zh: 所以就你离开时的学习阶段而言，在那种情况下，你需要自己努力去寻找一个新的实习岗位。

sentences.en: So, the course could help give you advice and guidance, but ultimately,
sentences.zh: 因此，课程可以帮你提供建议和指导，但归根结底，

sentences.en: the student is the one that would be responsible for looking to see what other CAP apprenticeships are being advertised and to apply for those and hopefully be successful.
sentences.zh: 学生自己才负责去查看有哪些其他的CAP学徒岗位在招聘，并去申请这些岗位，希望能被录用。

sentences.en: And the advantage for those employing services are that this CAP student won't have to take as long to finish because they would have done part of their CAP training before then.
sentences.zh: 而对于那些雇佣服务机构来说，好处是这位CAP学生不需要花那么长时间就能完成学业，因为他们在此之前已经完成了部分CAP培训。

sentences.en: Yeah, so there's some flexibility, much like any sort of educational programme, you can actually take breaks in learning.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以有一定的灵活性，就像任何教育项目一样，你实际上可以暂停学习。

sentences.en: So, that's, in a way, that's been quite a revelation to me because I never knew these things when I wasn't working in education.
sentences.zh: 所以，从某种程度上讲，这对我来说算是一个全新的发现，因为我以前不从事教育工作时根本不知道这些。

sentences.en: So, if, for example, a trainee clinical psychologist started year one or year two and were driving hours and hours and hours of placement each day
sentences.zh: 因此，举个例子，如果一名临床心理学实习生开始读第一年或第二年，每天花好几个小时开车去实习地点，

sentences.en: and they thought that might be sustainable, but it, obviously, we know that that was always going to be a tricky ask.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这可能是可持续的，但很显然，我们知道这从一开始就是一个相当苛刻的要求。

sentences.en: There isn't that flexibility to, for example, you know, move from an Edinburgh course to a Leicester course at the moment because they're entirely separate.
sentences.zh: 目前并没有那种灵活性，比如从爱丁堡的课程转到莱斯特的课程，因为它们是完全独立的。

sentences.en: And that's really tricky because when you're deciding to leave a trainee psychologist role, you're essentially saying, I'm done or I will start again somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 这真的很棘手，因为当你决定辞去心理学实习生角色时，你基本上是在说：我不干了，或者我要在别的地方重新开始。

sentences.en: And it sounds like there's more flexibility in a trainee CAP role.
sentences.zh: 听起来在CAP实习岗位中会有更多的灵活性。

sentences.en: Yes, I think there is.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't know of any examples where people have actually switched from one programme to another.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不知道有什么人从一个项目真正转到另一个项目的例子。

sentences.en: But it is possible in theory because each programme is having to follow the same learning objectives.
sentences.zh: 但在理论上是可能的，因为每个项目都必须遵循相同的学习目标。

sentences.en: It's quite specific expectations from the apprenticeship side and the BPS side of what actually they need to learn.
sentences.zh: 学徒制方面和BPS方面对他们实际需要学习的内容有着相当具体的期望。

sentences.en: So, I guess it would be more difficult if they were being trained in one of the more specialist areas, you know, like learned disabilities or older adults or health,
sentences.zh: 所以，我想如果他们是在其中一个更专业的领域接受培训，你知道的，比如学习障碍、老年人或健康领域，

sentences.en: if they then tried to get back into a programme that was mainly adult focused.
sentences.zh: 如果他们随后试图进入一个主要以成人为重点的项目，可能会更加困难。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if there are any other courses that have had this happen yet, but I'm sure there's room for precedent.
sentences.zh: 我不确定是否还有其他课程发生过这种情况，但我确信有先例可循的空间。

sentences.en: I think it would be more easy to come back into the same course, but having taken a break and changing workplace.
sentences.zh: 我想回到同一门课程会更容易一些，但前提是已经休学了一段时间并更换了工作场所。

sentences.en: So, we definitely have an example of that in our programme.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们的项目中确实有这样的例子。

sentences.en: Somebody's taken a break and then come back in later on in a new placement.
sentences.zh: 有人休学了一段时间，然后后来在新的实习岗位上重新加入了进来。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And just before we finish, have you got any of your top tips, like even just a top tip, for how to reduce burnout in aspiring psychologists?
sentences.zh: 在我们结束之前，你有什么顶级建议吗，哪怕只是一个顶级建议，告诉我们如何减少有志成为心理学家的人的职业倦怠？

sentences.en: Because we do ask a lot of our aspiring psychologists at times, don't we?
sentences.zh: 因为有时我们对这些立志成为心理学家的人要求确实很高，对吧？

sentences.en: So, I would say to bear in mind that psychology is not everything.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为要记住：心理学并不是生活的全部。

sentences.en: I know when a person is younger or when they're quite focused on an ambition and have like really clear plans of how they're going to get there,
sentences.zh: 我知道当一个人还年轻，或者当他们非常专注于某个雄心壮志，并且对如何实现目标有着非常清晰的计划时，

sentences.en: it can kind of take over a bit because it is a, it can be a very challenging profession to get into.
sentences.zh: 这可能会在某种程度上占据他们的全部生活，因为要进入这个行业确实非常具有挑战性。

sentences.en: But I would say to everybody, don't give up, you know, if that's really what you want to do, stay focused on it.
sentences.zh: 但我会告诉所有人：不要放弃，你知道的，如果那真的是你想做的事，就要保持专注。

sentences.en: But, you know, enjoy other aspects of your life as well.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，也要享受生活中其他方面的乐趣。

sentences.en: Psychologists are better when they're more rounded people and when they have particular interests in certain areas.
sentences.zh: 当心理学家们成为更全面的人，并且在某些特定领域有个人爱好时，他们会表现得更好。

sentences.en: So, that's going to help you have a longer career if you aren't just solely focused on psychology and, you know, all the things you do.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你不仅仅把精力完全集中在心理学以及你所做的所有事情上，这将有助于你延长职业生涯。

sentences.en: So, I would say, you know, you've got to have like looking after your health in terms of physical health,
sentences.zh: 所以我想说，你知道的，你必须照顾好自己的健康，包括身体健康，

sentences.en: looking after your mental health in terms of well-being, keep good friends, you know, have hobbies, a range of things that you're interested in.
sentences.zh: 在心理健康方面照顾好自己的福祉，结交好朋友，你知道的，培养爱好，培养各种感兴趣的事物。

sentences.en: It also makes you, I think it makes you a good practitioner too.
sentences.zh: 这也让你，我认为这也让你成为一个优秀的从业者。

sentences.en: If you've got other things that you're involved in, it certainly helps with conversation.
sentences.zh: 如果你还参与了其他事情，这肯定对对话交流大有裨益。

sentences.en: You know, if you're a well-rounded person, you're going to be able to, your clients are going to, are going to get that impression.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你是一个全面发展的人，你就能做到这一点，你的来访者也会有这种印象。

sentences.en: You're going to find a relationship building a lot easier.
sentences.zh: 你会发现建立关系要容易得多。

sentences.en: I hope that answers the question.
sentences.zh: 希望这回答了这个问题。

sentences.en: It really does.
sentences.zh: 确实回答了。

sentences.en: Yeah, you've got to be a human first and a psychologist second, haven't you?
sentences.zh: 是的，你必须先做一个人，其次才是心理学家，对吧？

sentences.en: And it's about being personable because, you know, those conversations where you're walking from reception to clinic room,
sentences.zh: 这关乎平易近人，因为，你知道的，从接待处走到临床咨询室的那些对话中，

sentences.en: you know, that's where you're supposed to be a little bit more natural, a little bit more human.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那正是你应该表现得更自然、更有人情味的时候。

sentences.en: And I don't know what your experiences are, but I found since the pandemic that there's been much more person in clinicians
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们的经历如何，但我发现自大流行以来，临床医生身上展现出的人性化特质多了很多，

sentences.en: because it's really been a levelling experience that really does put us all kind of in a similar position of uncertainty and threat and menace and all of that.
sentences.zh: 因为这确实是一次具有抚平差异的经历，它确实把我们所有人都置于一种类似的充满不确定性、威胁、恐惧以及诸如此类的处境中。

sentences.en: And that really did affect, I think, yeah, everybody that I've spoken to has sort of said, yeah, it is different now.
sentences.zh: 这确实产生了影响，我想，是的，我交谈过的每个人都某种程度上说：是的，现在真的不一样了。

sentences.en: It is just a bit different.
sentences.zh: 确实有点不一样了。

sentences.en: I think it gave people the time to reflect on, you know, what people say, the work-life balance,
sentences.zh: 我认为这让人们有时间反思，你知道的，人们所说的：工作与生活的平衡，

sentences.en: work-life, home balance, family relationships, downtime, how important it is to keep that balance going.
sentences.zh: 工作与家庭生活的平衡、家庭关系、闲暇时间，以及保持这种平衡有多么重要。

sentences.en: Because if you're giving too much at work, you're not, you haven't got that time to recharge yourself.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你在工作上付出太多，你就不会有时间来让自己重新充电。

sentences.en: You're going to be a better clinician for your clients and you're going to be a better colleague for the people you work with.
sentences.zh: 你将成为客户更好的临床医生，也将成为你同事们更好的工作伙伴。

sentences.en: If you've got that sort of balance, it's not always going to be perfect, but if you've got it in mind of why it's important to keep it going,
sentences.zh: 如果你能保持这种平衡——虽然不可能永远完美，但只要你心里明白为什么维持它很重要，

sentences.en: that's going to help you a long way from trying to protect yourself from burnout.
sentences.zh: 这将对你避免职业倦怠起到很大的帮助。

sentences.en: And always take your annual leave as well.
sentences.zh: 而且一定要休年假。

sentences.en: That would be another thing I'd say.
sentences.zh: 这是我要给的另一个建议。

sentences.en: I mean, annual leave is there for you to take at regular points.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，年假就是留给你在定期的时间休的。

sentences.en: I know it's easy to think, you know, you just want to keep it for like one long chunk.
sentences.zh: 我知道很容易让人觉得，你知道的，你只想把它留作一个长假。

sentences.en: But my advice would be, you know, take bits of time off regularly throughout the whole year and do something that's completely unrelated to your work, unrelated to psychology.
sentences.zh: 但我的建议是，你知道的，在全年中定期休掉一部分时间，做一些完全与工作无关、与心理学无关的事情。

sentences.en: Have some fun.
sentences.zh: 去玩得开心点。

sentences.en: Recharge that aspect of yourself that's not the psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 给不作为心理学家的那一部分自己充充电。

sentences.en: Yeah, I so agree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我太赞同了。

sentences.en: Such brilliant advice.
sentences.zh: 真是太棒的建议了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time in speaking with us today, Dawn.
sentences.zh: 多恩，非常感谢你今天抽空与我们交谈。

sentences.en: It's been a really, really interesting, insightful episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一期非常非常有趣、富有洞察力的节目。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不用客气。

sentences.en: I hope it can give some of your listeners, your viewers, some confidence and encouragement to keep going with, you know,
sentences.zh: 我希望这能给你们的一些听众、观众带来一些信心和鼓励，让他们继续坚持，你知道的，

sentences.en: their ideas about becoming a psychologist and where they can perhaps train in different roles, different psychological roles.
sentences.zh: 他们成为心理学家的想法，以及他们如何在不同的角色、不同的心理学角色中进行培训。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: It absolutely will do.
sentences.zh: 绝对会的。

sentences.en: Thank you again.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Thank you for watching.
sentences.zh: 谢谢观看。

sentences.en: And thank you so much for my guest time talking through this important area, which I really do think is an exciting development for psychology.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢我的嘉宾花时间探讨这个重要的领域，我真的认为这对心理学来说是一个令人兴奋的发展。

sentences.en: So it has been around a few years now, but hopefully it will become a really viable and enjoyable career for people and not just seen as a hop,
sentences.zh: 所以它其实已经存在好几年了，但希望它能成为人们真正可行且享受的职业，而不仅仅被视为什么，

sentences.en: step and a jump to be able to get on to do a doctorate.
sentences.zh: 为了考博士而必须经历的跳板。

sentences.en: I'd love to know what you think about this.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你对此有什么看法。

sentences.en: Has this inspired you to look for trainee cap roles?
sentences.zh: 这是否启发你去寻找见习临床助理心理学家的职位？

sentences.en: Do come and let me know in the Aspiring Psychologist Community free Facebook group.
sentences.zh: 快来在“有志心理学家社区”免费Facebook群组里告诉我吧。

sentences.en: I'd also love it if you take a moment to rate and review us on either Apple Podcasts or Spotify, as that helps the podcast to be reaching a wider audience.
sentences.zh: 如果你能花点时间在Apple Podcasts或Spotify上为我们打分和评论，我也会非常感激，因为这有助于播客触达更广泛的听众。

sentences.en: Whatever time of year it is, it's always a good time to dive into the books Clinical Psychologist Collective and the Aspiring Psychologist Collective too.
sentences.zh: 无论是一年中的什么时候，现在都是深入阅读《临床心理学家合集》和《有志心理学家合集》的好时机。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: I will look forward to bringing the next episode to you, which will be available from 10 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我期待为你带来下一期节目，该节目将于周六上午10点

sentences.en: on Saturdays on YouTube and from 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 在YouTube上发布，并于周一上午6点

sentences.en: on Mondays as an MP3.
sentences.zh: 以MP3形式发布。

sentences.en: Thank you again and be kind to yourselves.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢，善待自己。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚取超越“出售时间换取金钱”的收入呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特（Marian Trent）博士，一名临床心理学家，我从2019年开始一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One2Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特（Sophie Foote）的“One2Many”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年亲自完成了该项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的心路历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的赠品以及我独家的支持礼包，且不产生额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团指导、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆与梅森（Fortnum and Mason）礼品，以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的专属页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的赠品。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
